Above I have explained a simple sequence of steps for accurately documenting excessive emissions of an air pollutant from an industrial facility, as used by an air-quality report of the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality.

Does anyone here see anything wrong with this sequence of steps? On the face of it, the report does what it claims to do, which is to quantify emissions of air pollutants for 56 industrial facilities in the Houston, Texas metropolitan area.

The result is several conclusions that document excessive emissions of air pollutants, including:

- Benzene, a carcinogen.
- 1,3-butadiene, a carcinogen.
- Formaldehyde, a carcinogen.
